y-m-44-08.title: Umgca ubuyela apho wawukhona, ngoko kutheni isangqa singakwazi?
y-m-44-08.topic: Iimeko apho ukuhambisa kubeka umgca okanye isangqa phezu kwabo
y-m-44-08.goal: Thelekisa izilingano zemilo ehanjisiweyo ukufumana imeko apho umgca uhamba phezu kwawo (n = 2m), uze ucacise ukuba kutheni isangqa singenakho ukuhambisa okunjalo.
y-m-44-08.material: Ukuba uhambisa umlo kwiplani yekhowudinethi m ngasekunene kunye n phezulu, onke amachaphaza omlo ahamba ngacala linye ngomgama ofanayo. Masihambise umgca y = 2x + 1 nesangqa (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 sijonge iziphumo.
y-m-44-08.prereq.1: Ulwazi lwangaphambili: indlela ulingano olutshintsha ngayo ngokuhambisa (tshintshela x ngo-x − m kwaye y ngo-y − n), ithambeka lomgca, neziko nerediyasi yesangqa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.prompt: Iziphumo zovavanyo lokuhambisa zityhilwa enye ngexesha. Ixesha ngalinye, khetha ingcinga enengqiqo ngolwazi lokuza kuthi ga ngoku.

y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Xa umgca y = 2x + 1 wahanjiswa ngama-3 ngasekunene nge-1 phezulu, waba yi-y = 2x − 4. (Ngumgca owahlukileyo kunowawungaphambi kokuhambisa.)
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ingaba kunokwenzeka ukuhambisa lo mgca uye phezu kwawo ngokuhambisa?

y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ukuhambisa rhoqo kwenza umgca ube ngumgca owahlukileyo, ngoko akunakwenzeka ukuhambisa uye phezu kwawo

y-m-44-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana zonke iimeko (zingaphi?) apho imigca emithathu ingenakwenza unxantathu ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lika-k, uze ubhale isizathu ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini.
y-m-44-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ufumane ukudibana kuka-l₁ no-l₂, uze emva koko ufumane u-k owenza u-l₃ ahambe kuloo chaphaza.
y-m-44-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha elinye ixabiso lika-k uze uhlole ukuba amachaphaza amathathu okudibana ayahluka komnye nomnye na.

y-m-44-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubandakanye kwisizathu sakho inyaniso yokuba akukho meko yokuyafana?
